headline: Kospi Soars 2.9%, Asian Bourses Celebrate Nvidia's Earnings Performance
summary: Asia-Pacific shares strengthened, led by South Korea, with the Kospi rising 2.9% in a rally that reports attribute to Nvidia's earnings performance.
why: Asian equity indexes, particularly South Korea's Kospi, carry heavy exposure to semiconductor makers that supply the global AI chip chain.

impacts.name: Kospi
impacts.why: Index rose 2.9% in a regional rally linked to the Nvidia results.
